name: guild
description: Continuous agent orchestration on a Turso-backed board where status is a column, not a directory. A live 3-way interview between product-owner, architect, and user plans each requirement; goals and phases give it direction; the board then drives parallel development, test planning, unit & integration testing, and a 4-reviewer pass that produces a report for user-approved fixes. 'guild brief' narrates the board and 'guild dashboard' renders it as one offline HTML page, while an independent QA discipline files bugs and maps risk coverage as rows. Recovery is a journal replay. Say 'check in' to start a work session.
